title_zh: 免費兩日創傷研討會：身體記住的創傷，用感覺慢慢療癒
title_en: Free 2-Day Trauma Conference: The Body Keeps the Score — Trauma Healing Through the Senses with Bessel van der Kolk
summary_zh: Psychotherapy Networker（PESI）免費兩日線上創傷研討會。2026 年 12 月 5–6 日美中時間 09:00–16:00 舉行（港澳 12 月 5 日及 6 日 23:00 至翌日 06:00），由 Bessel van der Kolk 醫學博士主講，聯同 Licia Sky，講解發展性創傷、依附、創傷壓力神經生物學，以及 EMDR、瑜伽、正念與神經回饋等身體取向治療。報名後可享 14 日免費重溫。
summary_en: A free 2-day live virtual trauma conference from Psychotherapy Networker (PESI) on 5-6 December 2026, 9:00am-4:00pm Central each day (23:00 Macau time to 06:00 the next day), led by Bessel van der Kolk, MD, with Licia Sky. It covers developmental trauma, attachment, the neurobiology of traumatic stress, and body-oriented treatments including EMDR, yoga, mindfulness and neurofeedback. Free registration includes 14-day access to the recording.
